meta.label: Earth-2 FourCastNet NIM connection
meta.description: Connection to an NVIDIA Earth-2 FourCastNet NIM (self-hosted, or the NVIDIA hosted API) and the model version it serves.

params.name: base_url
params.label: NIM base URL
params.description: e.g. http://fourcastnet.nim-services.svc.cluster.local:8000 (prefer the in-cluster service URL; load balancer idle timeouts break long streams)

params.name: api_key
params.label: NVIDIA API key
params.description: API key for the NVIDIA hosted API (build.nvidia.com)

params.name: model_id
params.label: Model
params.description: Must match the NIM image you deployed

params.name: gpu_memory_gb
params.label: GPU memory (GB)
params.description: Optional. Memory of the single GPU running the NIM, used by the preflight check (e.g. 48 for an L40S, 80 for an H100)
